e.title: Etherisc GIF (DIP Platform)
e.summary: Etherisc 去中心化保险协议平台（73★）：在区块链上构建保险产品的通用框架（GIF/DIP）
e.body: Etherisc GIF（etherisc-legacy/GIF，73★，DIP Platform 联合仓库）是 Etherisc 的去中心化保险协议（Decentralized Insurance Protocol）平台：在区块链上构建去中心化保险产品的通用框架——保单生命周期（购买/理赔/赔付）的智能合约模板、市场与监管框架；Etherisc 生态的核心框架（HurricaneGuard 等产品构建其上）。对 RIAA：区块链保险产品的开发框架——理解如何用智能合约搭建参数险/理赔产品（[[hurricaneguard]]、[[healthcare-insurance-ethereum]] 即其用例）；与 [[ibm-blockchain-insurance]]（企业许可链路线）对照公链 vs 许可链；参数险产品衔接 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 的定价逻辑。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Etherisc DIP 去中心化保险协议平台（通用保险框架），73★
e.summary_en: Etherisc decentralised-insurance protocol platform (73★): the generic framework (GIF/DIP) for building insurance products on blockchain
e.summary_hk: Etherisc 去中心化保險協議平台（73★）：在區塊鏈上構建保險產品的通用框架（GIF/DIP）
e.body_en: Etherisc GIF (etherisc-legacy/GIF, 73★, the joint DIP Platform repository) is Etherisc's Decentralized Insurance Protocol platform: a generic framework for building decentralised insurance products on blockchain — smart-contract templates for the policy lifecycle (purchase/claims/payout), markets and regulatory framing; the core framework of the Etherisc ecosystem (HurricaneGuard etc. are built on it). For RIAA: a development framework for blockchain insurance products — understand how parametric/claims products are built with smart contracts ([[hurricaneguard]] and [[healthcare-insurance-ethereum]] are its use cases); compare the public-chain vs permissioned-chain routes with [[ibm-blockchain-insurance]]; parametric products connect to the pricing logic of [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]].
e.body_hk: Etherisc GIF（etherisc-legacy/GIF，73★，DIP Platform 聯合倉庫）是 Etherisc 的去中心化保險協議（Decentralized Insurance Protocol）平台：在區塊鏈上構建去中心化保險產品的通用框架——保單生命週期（購買/理賠/賠付）的智能合約模板、市場與監管框架；Etherisc 生態的核心框架（HurricaneGuard 等產品構建其上）。對 RIAA：區塊鏈保險產品的開發框架——理解如何用智能合約搭建參數險/理賠產品（[[hurricaneguard]]、[[healthcare-insurance-ethereum]] 即其用例）；與 [[ibm-blockchain-insurance]]（企業許可鏈路線）對照公鏈 vs 許可鏈；參數險產品銜接 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 的定價邏輯。
